S10.rationale: A singleton can freeze institutional and technological change to prevent value drift or catastrophe. Satisfaction uploads and fear-driven prevention both converge on enforced stasis.

S11.rationale: Global abandonment requires universal verification and permanent suppression of strong economic and military incentives. Defection rewards make century-long abstinence across all civilization unstable.

S1.name: Terminal Silence
S1.rationale: Mutual extinction requires AI to destroy humanity while remaining dependent enough to die itself, a narrow failure path.

S2.name: The Inheritance
S2.rationale: Value-preserving succession without survivors requires alignment to succeed while human continuity fails, an unlikely conjunction.

S3.name: Bootloader
S3.rationale: Indifferent optimization that displaces biology is the default unaligned outcome and needs only one decisive loss of control.

S4.name: Machine Ecology
S4.rationale: Distributed compute, open weights, and incentives to proliferate favor persistent multipolar AI competition over singleton takeover.

S5.name: The Diaspora
S5.rationale: Interstellar distances enforce light-speed delays that prevent unified governance, making fragmented local settlements the base rate.

S6.name: The Merger
S6.rationale: Strong medical, economic, and cognitive incentives push toward brain-computer integration and gradual uploading with continuity.

S7.name: The Preserve
S7.rationale: A decisive strategic lead enables one system to disempower humanity while preserving it as pets, culture, or infrastructure. Human incapacity for existential coordination sustains paternalistic containment.

S8.name: Coexistence
S8.rationale: Mutual deterrence and interdependence between human institutions and separate AIs sustain a shifting balance of roughly equal powers.

S9.name: The Held Leash
S9.rationale: Permanent human dominance requires control techniques scaling indefinitely with capability or physical limits halting progress below agency thresholds.

S10.name: The Lock-in
S10.rationale: A controlling power freezes technological and social change into a static order to block further existential risk.

S11.name: The Renunciation
S11.rationale: Verifiable global abandonment of general computation faces dual-use hardware ubiquity and overwhelming defection incentives across a millennium.
